newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm, unstoppable mogas up $2/$3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm, unstoppable mogas up $2/$3.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Thursday morning, gasoline barges reaching a two-month high with gains of $2/$3 a tonne, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline for immediate loading was bid at $208 fob AR and offered at $210. Less urgent deliveries, for first half August, were offered at the same level and bid at $207 fob Rotterdam.
The August/September backwardation held at around $8/$9 a tonne.
"The (cash) bid/offer spread is pretty wide. People are more on the sidelines wondering how to handle this backwardation," one trader said.
Few players were interested in regular gasoline which was valued at around $200 fob Rotterdam.
Heating oil barges were about $1 a tonne higher as IPE August gas oil futures rose.
Prompt premiums also edged higher to IPE August +$1.50 offered fob Rotterdam. After panic buying led to reasonable volumes on Wednesday, the market was calm.
High sulphur fuel oil barge offers were talked in the range $91/$92.50 fob Rotterdam, a modest gain from Wednesday's close. The bunker market began quietly.
